service.method:
SELECT BIZ_CODE AS SIGNER_COMPANY_CODE , SEQ , USER_ID AS SIGNER_ID , USER_NAME AS SIGNER_NAME , EMAIL AS SIGNER_EMAIL , PHONE_NO AS SIGNER_PHONE , IF_FLAG FROM SBUPI WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BIZ_CODE = ${BIZ_CODE} AND #DB_OWNER#nvl(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
AND ( USER_ID LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' OR USER_NAME LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' OR EMAIL LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' OR PHONE_NO LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' )

SELECT USMT.COMPANY_CODE AS SIGNER_COMPANY_CODE , CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC AS SIGNER_COMPANY_NAME , ADDR.CEO_NAME_LOC AS SIGNER_COMPANY_OWNER , ADDR.ADDRESS_LOC AS SIGNER_COMPANY_ADDR , CMGL.IRS_NO , USMT.USER_ID AS SIGNER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS SIGNER_NAME , USMT.EMAIL AS SIGNER_EMAIL , USMT.PHONE AS SIGNER_PHONE FROM SUSMT USMT INNER JOIN SADDR ADDR ON ADDR.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND ADDR.CODE_NO = USMT.USER_ID INNER JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON CMGL.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND CMGL.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE WHERE USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND #DB_OWNER#nvl(USMT.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
AND ( USMT.USER_ID LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' OR USMT.USER_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' OR USMT.PHONE LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' OR USMT.EMAIL LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' )
